text:
Gold Price in 1984
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1984, the LBMA gold price fell 17.5% between 1984-01-31 ($374) and 1984-12-31 ($308). The highest sampled price was $394 in February and the lowest was $308 in December. The mean of these observations was $358. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
